cards.label: check
cards.title: Worried you'll get it wrong?
cards.text: I can make sure the science is right.
cards.example: e.g., read a script or watch a cut before it goes out

cards.label: explain
cards.title: Stuck on a paper?
cards.text: I can explain a dense research paper in plain language.
cards.example: e.g., a one-page summary of what a new study does and does not show

cards.label: teach
cards.title: Confused by the science??
cards.text: I can teach a concept, on camera or off.
cards.example: e.g., a plain-language walk-through of how we perceive something

cards.label: demo
cards.title: Want a demo that lands?
cards.text: I can suggest or build demos and illusion to make the idea click.

cards.label: test
cards.title: Want your audience to experience it?
cards.text: I can design a simple experiment your audience can take part in.
cards.example: e.g., a web-based demo viewers do at home with results you can show

cards.label: guest
cards.title: Need an expert on camera?
cards.text: I can join you for an interview, a live demo, or a short explainer.
cards.example: e.g., a live illusion and explanation

cards.label: sources
cards.title: Looking for evidence?
cards.text: I can point you to the right papers or people.
cards.example: e.g., a reading list or an intro to the lab that did the work
